title: 部长警告说，要储备食物以应对极端天气
content: 图片来源，Getty Images 作者：Archie Mitchell 商业记者 1小时前发布 一位政府部长警告说，随着一代人以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺事件在太平洋上空发展，家庭应该储备食物，为极端天气做好准备。环境大臣安吉拉·伊格尔女士告诉卫报，强大的自然气候现象将导致“这个国家出现更多极端风暴”。她发表此番言论之际，国家审计署（NAO）警告英国食品供应鉴于网络攻击和气候危机的威胁日益严重，该产业链正面临风险。国家审计署表示，政府过于依赖私营部门来应对粮食供应中断问题。政府将于今年晚些时候公布一项为国家紧急情况做准备的战略。安吉拉夫人对外表示：“我们即将经历可能是有史以来最大的厄尔尼诺现象，这将导致这个国家的夏季更加干燥，冬季更加潮湿，并出现更多极端风暴。洪水将在亚洲造成更大的损失，因此我认为我们需要认真对待它。” “在紧急服务到达之前，先坚持一段时间，你的情况会比没有好得多。”“因此，其中一些就是为了增强韧性而做的准备。”她发表此番言论之际，英国国家审计署的一份报告警告说，英国的食品供应链很容易受到植物或人类疾病爆发、网络攻击和极端天气的影响。报告还指出，气候变化是一种长期的慢性风险，可能使英国的食品供应面临风险。这些中断可能会推高价格，让弱势群体变得脆弱。报告称，英国食品、环境和农村事务部（Defra）过于依赖私营公司来应对食品供应中断。该部还补充说，该部门近年来在提高供应链弹性方面做得不够。英国家庭对紧急情况的准备程度低于芬兰、瑞典和欧盟国家等其他国家。英国国家审计署补充说，部长们应鼓励家庭为供应链中断做好准备，并学习其他国家采取的方法。被告知如何为网络攻击和天气紧急情况做好准备英国气象局称，7月14日发布的厄尔尼诺现象将是“人们记忆中最强烈的一次”，Defra表示，该报告显示食品供应风险正变得更加复杂，政府正在与农民和工业界合作，以增强英国的抵御能力。一位发言人表示：“我们希望建立富有成效和可持续的粮食系统。”7月，政府宣布了计划，制定家庭可以采取的“小但重要的步骤”，为极端天气或网络攻击时的食物和水短缺做好准备。这些将形成一项将于2026年底公布的战略，旨在使英国在应急准备方面与欧洲国家更加接近。代表运输温控食品的公司的冷链联盟首席执行官菲尔·普拉克表示，英国“相当不错”。他告诉英国广播公司（BBC）的“唤醒金钱”节目，该国正成为俄罗斯网络黑客的目标，他们“知道食品供应系统中存在关键点”。他补充说，厄尔尼诺现象以及全球航运中断和流行病的威胁意味着你不能“每次都依赖私营部门的帮助”。当被问及人们是否应该在出现中断时储备库存时，普拉克补充道：“是的，我们应该这样做。”每个家庭都会备货，政府将在秋季告诉我们所有人都这样做。”相关主题食品工业

title: 特朗普质疑美国对英国的支持，阿根廷米莱岛争端升级
content:
阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱加剧了围绕福克兰群岛的长期争端，重申该国对英国海外自治领土的主权主张，并威胁要对在该群岛作业的石油公司实施制裁。

米莱在全国电视讲话中隔夜表示，阿根廷将“需要收复”这些岛屿，阿根廷称之为“拉斯马尔维纳斯群岛”，并呼吁该国据天空新闻报道，“不袖手旁观”并“向世界展示统一战线”。

Milei 还宣布计划实施经济处罚，旨在阻止海狮石油项目的开发，该项目是福克兰群岛以北约 220 公里（137 英里）处的一个大型海上石油开发项目。

该项目由英国 Rockhopper Exploration 和以色列 Navitas Petroleum 共同开发，目标是在2028 年初。阿根廷认为该合资企业在其声称拥有主权的水域非法开采资源。

CNBC 已联系纳维塔斯石油公司，正在等待回应。 Rockhopper Exploration 拒绝置评。

在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普拒绝透露未来与阿根廷因福克兰群岛发生冲突时美国是否会援助英国后不久，米莱发表了上述言论。本周早些时候，特朗普在接受英国广播公司采访时暗示，由于英国被认为缺乏对伊朗战争的支持，美国不会在这些岛屿问题上支持英国。

美国总统此前曾暗示，如果英国未能提高国防开支，华盛顿可以修改其在福克兰群岛主权问题上的中立立场。

米莱经常将自己描绘成与特朗普在拉丁美洲意识形态上相对应的人，他吹捧自己与美国的密切关系。美国总统在讲话中表示，白宫正在考虑改变在福克兰群岛问题上的立场，因为阿根廷已经表明“在未来几十年里可以成为一个有价值的盟友”。

米莱的讲话似乎标志着阿根廷总统语气的重大转变，此前他在寻求改善与英国的关系时优先考虑通过外交手段解决该问题。

英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷周五表示，米莱的声明“更多地告诉我们阿根廷的国内政治，而不是福克兰群岛。”

斯特里廷在 aposton 社交媒体上补充道：“福克兰群岛是英国的，因为福克兰群岛居民选择成为英国人。我们对福克兰群岛的承诺是绝对的、不可动摇的。”

福克兰群岛位于阿根廷南部海岸以东约 500 公里处。英国自 1833 年以来一直控制着这些岛屿。长期以来一直声称对福克兰群岛拥有主权的阿根廷曾于 1982 年与英国就该群岛进行了一场短暂而激烈的战争。

title: Mohamed El-Erian 告诉 CNBC，全球债券抛售可能尚未结束
content:
Investors should expect the sell-off of global government bonds to continue, renowned economist Mohamed El-Erian told CNBC on Friday.

"I don't see any appetite in the U.S. for immediate fiscal consolidation. So I suspect we will continue to see upward pressures on yields," he told CNBC's Carolin Roth at the Ambrosetti Forum in Cernobbio, Italy.

Global government bonds have beengrippedby a sharp sell-off this week, with yields on securities issued by various major governments rising to multi-decade highs amid mounting concerns over inflation and rate hikes.

Bond yields and prices move inversely to one another.

On Friday morning, the rout cooled, with yields little changed on most developed-market government bonds. U.S. Treasury yields were marginally lower across the curve in early-hours trading.

El-Erian, the Rene M. Kern Practice Professor at the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School and chief economic adviser at Allianz, told CNBC he did not see anything wrong with how the markets were functioning – but added that "reliable buyers and holders" of U.S. Treasurys were coming under pressure.

"China, for geopolitical purposes, is no longer as willing," he said. "Japan and the Gulf countries have domestic issues."

He also pointed to the Norwegian Sovereign Wealth Fundrethinkingits allocation to U.S. government bonds.

"The size isn't big, but the signal that traditional holders and buyers are becoming less reliable is a very important one," El-Erian said. "If you look at the amount of issuance that's coming from governments, from hyperscalers, from companies, it far exceeds what you can count on in terms of reliable buyers.

"And that's why there's been pressure on interest rates. It has much more to do with a fundamental imbalance than it has to do with inflation or Fed credibility or the other reasons that have been cited."

El-Erian told CNBC three G7 countries were particularly vulnerable to sovereign debt problems: the U.K., Japan and France.

"Those by numbers, by everything else, and the U.K. in particular is what I call a high-beta country," he said. "That every time rates move by a bit in the U.S., they move by a lot more in the U.K."

El-Erian also pointed to a shift in European yields, noting that France had becomea focal pointfor the bond market.

"In the old days you would worry about Italy. Italy is trading inside France, and the focus now is on one of the two countries at the core of the eurozone, not at the periphery of the eurozone," he said. "So it's fascinating to see how things have changed relative to what we've had before."

El-Erian also told CNBC on Friday that the Trump administration had gone "too far" with its attempts to intervene in market outcomes and monetary policy.

Last month, the U.S. Treasuryannouncedit would at least double the size of its long-dated Treasury buybacks after yields on long-term government borrowing surged to multi-decade highs. On Thursday, U.S. Vice President JD Vancecalledon the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates, renewing the administration's pressure on the central bank to reduce its key rate.

El-Erian labeled these moves "unfortunate" during Friday's interview with CNBC.

"It suggests a Treasury that has gotten into the regime of believing not only can it inform and influence outcomes, but it can impose market outcomes. I think that's a step too far," he said. "And the question now is, how do you step back from this? I think the results are clear. It's a massive market. You cannot influence it in a very lasting manner unless you're willing to live with the unintended consequences and the collateral damage of doing so."

CNBC reached out to the U.S. Treasury Department for comment.

He added that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, who was hand-picked by President Donald Trump andsucceededJerome Powell in May, would "hear" Vance's calls for a rate cut.

"It just gives you a sense that affordability has become so important politically that there will be pressure, and I think the main question here is not what 'does it mean for the Fed' [but] 'what does it mean for the Treasury' that he wants lower rates because of the mortgage market," El-Erian said.

Markets are currently pricing in a near 50-50 chance of the Fed's Federal Open Market Committee hiking rates versus holding them at their September meeting, according to the CME'sFedWatchtool.

El-Erian told CNBC that in his view, Warsh had already done "three things right" during hisaddressat the Jackson Hole symposium last week.

"First, he addressed the concerns about his reaction function," he said. "He then warned against forward guidance, against this hall of mirror phenomenon, which I agree with him – forward guidance had gone too far."

"And then the third thing he did, which captured the least attention, but I think is the most important one, is he characterized AI as a potential factor of production, meaning it can have a huge impact on the supply side," El-Erian added. "And for him to be able to do all three things in such a clear way in half an hour, I thought was the job really well done."

title: 交易员等待八月就业报告，股票期货几乎没有变化：实时更新
content:
Stock futures were little changed early Friday as traders looked ahead to August's big payrolls report.

Futures linked to theDow Jones Industrial Averagewere flat.S&P 500 futuresadded 0.05%, andNasdaq-100 futuresedged 0.17% higher.

In Thursday's regular trading, the three major averages rose. The 30-stockDowgained more than 600 points, or 1.2%, and posted its best day since Aug. 4. TheS&P 500climbed more than 1%, while theNasdaq Compositeadvanced 1.4%.

In Asia, markets opened higher Friday. South Korea'sKospijumped 1.13%, Japan'sNikkei 225added 0.74%, while Australia'sS&P/ASX 200was little changed. Hong Kong'sHang Seng Indexgained 1.9% and the mainland China's CSI 300 rose 0.89%.

U.S. stocks caught a tailwind as Treasury yields pulled back after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he would be "inclined" tosupport holding ratesat their current target range of 3.5% to 3.75% at the central bank's Sept. 15-16 meeting.

Traders have their eyes on the next market catalyst this week:August's jobs report, due Friday morning. Economists polled by Dow Jones expect 53,000 nonfarm payrolls were added last month, and they expect the unemployment rate to be 4.1%. This compares to a loss of 23,000 jobs in July.

"Inflation statistics next week will also be pivotal; however, ongoing decreases in employment should be enough for the central bank to start considering the labor side of its mandate when prescribing policy, rather than maintaining an unwavering commitment to quelling price pressures," said José Torres, senior economist at Interactive Brokers. He is eyeing the consumer price index and producer price index reports due next week.

Stocks are on pace for a winning week. The S&P 500 is on track for a 0.5% advance, while the Nasdaq is on pace for a 0.7% gain. The Dow is heading for a 0.2% jump.

Natural gas prices in Europe are hovering near a three-year high, after hitting their highest level early 2023 on Wednesday.

Gas traded on the Dutch TTF, the European benchmark, closed above 73 euros ($84.90) per megawatt-hour on Wednesday, with front-month futures contracts last seen trading at about 71.30 euros – marking an intraday decline of just over 3%.

Europe's gas stores are currently only two-thirds full, according to the Aggregated Gas Storage Inventory database.

Energy prices on the continent spiked in the wake of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, and have also come under pressure through the U.S.-Iran war. Many European nations are net importers of energy commodities.

Oil rose Friday, amid lingering concerns over supply disruptions as tensions between Iran and the U.S continued on.

Futures for international benchmarkBrent crudefor November delivery gained 0.41% at $95.91 a barrel. U.S.West Texas Intermediate futuresfor October advanced 0.69% at $91.93 per barrel.

Military hostilities in the region have escalated in recent days, reviving fears of a return to a broader war, and extended disruption to energy flows via the Strait of Hormuz.

"Physical flows in the Strait of Hormuz remain constrained, with traffic levels below normal," Quoc Dat Tong, senior financial markets strategist at Exness, told CNBC Thursday. "At the same time, ongoing efforts to sustain energy exports from the region help limit the upside bias for crude prices," Quoc added.

Treasury yields were stable across the curve on Friday, as traders continued to assess remarks by Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller that he wasleaning toward keeping interest rates unchangedat the central bank's next policy meeting in two weeks.

The10-year Treasury noteyield, the main benchmark for mortgages, was little changed at 4.766%.

The longer-dated30-year Treasuryyield dropped about 1 basis point to 5.241%.

The shorter2-year Treasury noteyield, which tends to tracks short-term Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, was 1 basis point higher at 4.344%.

Interactive Brokers in a note on Friday said Waller's remarks added to a broader dovish shift among policymakers, following similar comments from New York Fed President John Williams on easing inflation pressures.

The brokerage said expectations for lower rates were supporting Treasuries, particularly shorter-dated maturities that are more sensitive to Fed policy, while a rise in Challenger job cuts also boosted demand for fixed-income assets.

Bitcoinslid 0.79% to $80,903 on Friday, after topping $81,000 the day before to hit its highest level in nearly four months.

Ether last traded 0.15% lower at $2,510.64.

Further gains would depend on sustained institutional participation and greater clarity on the Federal Reserve's rate path, said Diana Pires, chief business officer at sFOX, adding that strong spot bitcoin ETF inflows and increased trading activity suggested the rally has broadened beyond the short squeeze that initially led to gains.

The crypto industry'sbiggest legislative betis hanging in the balance this month, with little confidence a key proposed bill will make it past the finish line.

The upcoming vote on the Clarity Act, which would establish a federal framework for crypto markets, represents a major test for an industry that has spent years lobbying Washington for clearer rules governing digital assets.

The Japanese yenwas trading at 155.89 against the dollar on Friday, after appreciating to its strongest since February on Thursday, as traders weighed the possibility of further Japanese currency intervention and rising expectations for Bank of Japan rate hikes.

The yen jumped more than 2% against the greenback on Thursday, at one point touching 155.28 per dollar, according to LSEG data.

JPMorgan still expects the yen to weaken to around 160 against the dollar, as Japanese authorities seek to maintain currency stability while the BOJ continues to raise rates.

"We remain neutral on the Japanese yen and expect USDJPY to hover around 160 as authorities prioritize currency stability. This view assumes the BOJ delivers 3-4 rate hikes over the next 12 months, taking policy rates to around 2%," the bank wrote in a note on Friday.

Asia-Pacific markets opened mostly higher Friday.

South Korea'sKospijumped 1.32%, while the small-cap Kosdaq was 1.99% higher. Japan'sNikkei 225added 0.25%, but the Topix index dipped 0.46%.

Australia'sS&P/ASX 200rose 0.14%.

Asia-Pacific markets were set to climb Friday, tracking Wall Street gains overnight as Treasury yields eased.

Japan'sNikkei 225was poised to rise, with the Chicago and Osaka futures contracts last at 64,665 and 64,660 respectively, compared with the index's previous close of 64,214.48.

Hong Kong'sHang Seng indexfutures were at 25,421, higher than the index's last close of 25,213.31.

Futures for Australia'sS&P/ASX 200last traded at 9,037, compared with the index's previous close of 9,020.1.

Several stocks made dramatic moves in extended trading as a slate of companies posted their latest earnings reports.

Lululemon Athletica— Shares of the sportswear manufacturer tanked 18% after the companyposted a glum forecastfor the current quarter. Lululemon called for earnings in a range of 93 cents to 98 cents per share on revenue of $2.29 billion to $2.32 billion. Analysts were looking for $2.40 per share and $2.53 billion.

Docusign— The software company jumped more than 4% after it reported an earnings and revenue beat in its second-quarter financial report. Docusign also hiked the high end of its full-year revenue guidance, as well as its full-year forecast for its non-GAAP operating margin.

Read more about movers in extended trading here.

Stock futures opened little changed on Thursday night.

Futures linked to theDow Jones Industrial Averageslipped 10 points, or 0.02%.S&P 500 futureslost 0.06% andNasdaq-100 futureswere down 0.1%.

title: 随着欧盟加入制裁，美国“经济弃儿”行动势头增强；韩国考虑军事支持
content:
欧盟已正式加入美国主导的针对伊朗的制裁行动，而韩国则表示正在权衡发挥军事作用，以帮助重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，华盛顿敦促盟友在金融和军事方面支持其对德黑兰的战争。

美国美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特赞扬欧盟签署了“经济放逐者行动”，这是美国领导的旨在将德黑兰与全球金融体系隔离的制裁行动。

贝森特在美国周四晚间的社交媒体帖子中表示：“我们赞赏他们强有力的早期立场。”他补充道：“世界正在向伊朗政权发出明确的信息：我们不会停止，除非所有剩余的金融生命线都被切断。”

此番言论是在布鲁塞尔于 8 月 31 日发表的声明中表示，支持旨在制止德黑兰“破坏稳定的活动”并恢复和谈的努力，包括通过“经济流亡者行动”，对伊斯兰政权施加额外的经济压力。

本周早些时候，20 名财政部长和央行行长齐聚北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔。

贝森特在周四的帖子中表示：“美国坚定地与我们的盟友站在一起，确保凶残的伊朗政权无法利用全球金融体系为其核野心、武器计划和恐怖代理人提供资金。”

特朗普政府于 8 月底发起了“经济流放行动”运动，目标是伊朗获取数字资产、先进技术采购、黄金等。储备、商业航空和航运。

伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴格海(Esmail Baghaei)反对欧盟支持他所说的华盛顿“经济恐怖主义”的举动。巴盖伊在 9 月 1 日的声明中猛烈抨击，称该集团已“向美国的胁迫投降了其主权、法律法规、价值观和道德规范。”贝森特将这场运动视为针对伊朗全球金融关系的“经济攻击”，并警告说，援助德黑兰的国家应该“期望分享一个衰弱政权的孤立”。中国是伊朗最大的贸易伙伴，战前购买了伊朗约 90% 的受制裁原油出口。

欧盟单独维持了针对伊朗核计划和弹道导弹计划的制裁制度，以及对俄罗斯的军事支持。

贝森特在峰会前表示，他打算敦促 G20 同行切断与德黑兰的金融关系，否则将面临二次制裁。他还表示每周都会实施新的二级制裁，最初重点针对银行，警告要切断那些促进伊朗相关交易的机构完全脱离以美元为基础的金融体系。

另外，据路透社周五援引青瓦台报道，韩国正在权衡各种选择，包括提供军事援助，以支持美国重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的商业航运。

然而，韩国政府否认了当地媒体关于已经做出决定的报道，称“与相关细节有关”据韩联社报道，在给记者的一份声明中，该问题尚未决定。

几家韩国媒体周四报道称，首尔准备在年底前向海湾地区派遣军队，并可能最早本月寻求议会批准。

华盛顿对首尔不愿在对伊朗战争中提供军事援助（包括缩减上个月的年度联合军事演习）表示不满。并取消了原定于 9 月举行的登陆演习。

该地区的军事敌对行动最近几天加剧，再次引发了人们对重新爆发更广泛战争的担忧。

美国军方本周早些时候发动了新一波袭击，袭击了伊朗的军事目标，以报复对该地区船只和美军的袭击。伊朗进行了报复，向美国在中东的军事基地发射了导弹。

穿过霍尔木兹海峡（战前约五分之一的全球石油流量的咽喉要道）的航运仍然受到抑制，伊朗定期对使用阿曼海岸附近南部航道的船只进行袭击。

美国一直在该海峡保持海上封锁，阻止船只进出伊朗港口，以拖延伊朗的石油供应。国家的原油运输量。美国中央司令部周五表示，已调整 87 艘商船的航向，关闭其中三艘并登上两艘，以确保完全合规。

title: 阿根廷领导人威胁要制裁石油公司并重申马岛主权主张
content: Image source,ReutersByWill Grant,ÂBBC's Mexico, Central America and Cuba correspondent,ÂChris GrahamÂandÂPeter Hoskins,ÂBusiness reporterPublished4 September 2026, 03:01 BSTUpdated 1 hour agoArgentina's president has heightened tensions with the UK over the Falkland Islands, warning he will impose economic sanctions on firms which exploit oil close to the British overseas territory.In a national address, Javier Milei said the "winds of change" favoured Argentina's claim to the islands, emboldened by signs the US might reconsider its stance of neutrality on the issue.Milei said the Sea Lion oilfield, where a British and an Israeli firm are due to begin exploration work, was a "clear and present danger".More than 40 years after the war over the territory, sovereignty of the archipelago in the south-west Atlantic Ocean remains hotly disputed between Britain and Argentina.BBC News has contacted the UK government for comment on Milei's statement. The government reiterated this week that Falkland islanders "are British with a right to determine their own future".Milei announced his sanctions plan surrounded by his cabinet at the presidential palace, reiterating that the Falklands were "historically and legally" Argentinean.It is not yet clear how or to what extent the sanctions will be imposed or tightened. In Argentina, a current law already allows for restrictions of activities of oil companies participating in projects considered unauthorised on the islands.Teslyn Barkman, a former member of the Falkland Islands Legislative Assembly, told the BBC that Milei's speech had "probably irked every single Falkland islander".Speaking from the capital Stanley, she added that "we have a burgeoning economy for a small place... we will remain forever British".The crux was a proposal to introduce a bill to parliament to impose sanctions on energy firms planning to begin oil exploration off the Falklands.The Sea Lion oilfield,around 130 miles from the islands, contains an estimated 1.7 billion barrels of oil.Two oil companies â Britain's Rockhopper Exploration and Israel's Navitas Petroleum â are due to begin extracting oil in the Sea Lion oilfield off the Falklands coast within two years, something Milei said Argentina could not allow.Rockhopper has described the field as containing "highly marketable crude".In a video posted earlier this year, Navitas highlighted the work it is already carrying out in the Falklands including building a dock, a heliport and accommodation for oil workers.The BBC has contacted the two companies for responses to Milei's latest comments."If we do not act swiftly in a few months, they will have the material capacity to access the oil that lies underneath our sea â something that has never happened before," Milei said.In a 2013 referendum, residents of the islands voted overwhelmingly to remain a British overseas territory - with 99.8% voting in favour and just three voting against.Whenasked in an interview with GB News earlieron Thursday if the US would "come to the UK's aid" during a potential territorial dispute, Trump replied that Britain had "not been there to help me" with his country's war with Iran.Trump's latest remarks come after he previously saidthe US could revise its neutral positionon the islands' sovereignty if the UK failed to increase defence spending.Milei also announced plans for a naval base in Tierra del Fuego in the south of Argentina, saying Trump and the US were "assessing their historical position in regard to the Falklands", which Argentina refers to as Las Malvinas."That is not empty words as they understand that Argentina is a reliable partner and a valuable ally for decades to come," he said,describing the UK as a nation "in decline"."There are winds of change in the world that are favourable to our claim," Milei added.Hours before Milei's speech, Sarah Rogers, a senior official in the US state department, posted a photo of herself with Milei alongside the caption: "Exciting things are happening in the Western Hemisphere."Argentine forces landed on the Falklands to stake a territorial claim in 1982, sparking a 74-day war over the territory as a British military task force ejected them.The conflict led to the deaths of 255 British military personnel, three islanders and 649 Argentine military personnel.In a sign of the ongoing tensions between the two countries over the issue, Argentina players celebrated their victory over England in the World Cupby waving a bannerin support of their country's territorial claim.Get our flagship newsletter with all the headlines you need to start the day.Sign up here.Related topicsArgentinaFalkland IslandsOil & Gas industryMore on this storyTrump hints US would not back UK over Falkland Islands due to lack of Iran war supportPublished14 hours agoTrump says US position on Falklands 'one of many' title: 通胀精灵可能会破瓶而出——债券市场正在敲响警钟
content:
A sharp sell-off in global government bonds is exposing investor anxiety that the macroeconomic backdrop may be shifting toward persistently higher inflation, as governments struggle to rein in spending and sovereign debt.

Pressure on yields is not just a factor of this year's rise in government borrowing and higher energy prices. Investors highlight a pivot away from globalization toward protectionism, and geopolitical tensions, which have materialized in trade tariffs, industrial reshoring and increased defense spending, as signs of a broader shift that could keep inflation structurally higher.

That would mark a decisive break from the generally low and comparatively stable inflation environment that followed the global financial crisis — heralding wide-ranging implications for investors' portfolios.

"Structural features of the global economy have shifted and now create inflationary, rather than disinflationary impulses," said Emma Moriarty, portfolio manager at CG Asset Management.

"Tariffs, and then more recently, the outbreak of war in the Middle East have been the sharp end of this changing order. It is wrong to think of the energy shock as temporary, as the underlying structural change that has caused it might be quite long-lived."

The U.S.10-year Treasuryyield climbed to its highest level since November 2023 this week, whileJapan's 10-year government bondyield moved above 3% for the first time since 1996. In the U.K., yields on10-year Gilts— the benchmark for Britain's government debt — hit a post-2008 high, as German10-year bundyields, a barometer for euro zone borrowing, rose to levels not seen since 2011.

Longer-dated yields in those countries also touched multi-year or multi-decade highs.

Jon Cunliffe, head of investment office at JM Finn, said that while cyclical inflation pressures may continue to moderate, investors should not assume a return to the persistently low and stable inflation regime that prevailed between 2010 and 2020.

"The key unknown is the extent to which AI will exert a disinflationary pull via a significant boost to productivity — this is certainly what new Fed Chair [Kevin] Warsh is hoping for as U.S. policymakers wrestle with growing fiscal dominance," Cunliffe told CNBC via email.

Investors say this week's yield spike, particularly at the longer end of the curve, underlines investor demands for a higher term premium in the face of greater fiscal borrowing requirements, persistent inflation uncertainty and reduced central bank support for government debt in some major economies.

Speaking with CNBC on Wednesday, Haig Bathgate, CEO at Callanish Capital said that while this week's sell-off reflects a degree of short-term noise, sustained inflation across the term structure is "going to be a feature going forward in markets".

"At some point, this is going to come home to roost," Bathgate said of the "spiraling" public spending.

"We know from the '70s looking back at history, once the inflation genie is out the bottle, it's very hard to put it back in," he added. "It is more sustained than anybody thought."

Central banks now face an increasingly complex challenge over interest rate trajectories, with inflation still vulnerable to ongoing supply-side shocks and geopolitical disruption, but policymakers wary of aggressive tightening amid sluggish growth.

"In this context, the Bank of England and Federal Reserve may therefore tolerate temporary inflation overshoots while monitoring whether second-round wage and pricing effects emerge," said Cunliffe. "Elsewhere, however, the ECB and the BoJ are on a more definite tightening path, with the former targeting inflation versus growth, and the latter on a path to normalize monetary policy now that both growth and inflation are on a sustainable footing."

Odds for a rate hike at the nextFederal Open Market Committeelater this month rose to more than 66% followingFederal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's keynote speech at Jackson Hole, Wyoming on Friday Aug. 28, up from about 35% prior to his remarks.

Padhraic Garvey, regional head of research, Americas and head of global rates and debt strategy at ING, said the Iran war and elevated energy costs provide an additional upward pressure point on longer-dated yields. "This is especially a live problem for Europe to deal with, and for Asia, and indeed beyond," Garvey said in a note Thursday.

Brent crude— the international oil price benchmark — gained more than 1% on Thursday to reach $96.64, a one-month high, while U.S.West Texas Intermediateprices rose 1.6% to trade at $92.52 a barrel.

"If the music stopped now, the absolute level of long-end yields for many issuers looks reasonably fair. The problem is the music is still blaring. A lot is going on, and most of the pressure continues to point upwards for long rates. That does not have to be a drama, but then again, it could become one should it get pushed too far," Garvey added.

"It's tough to see the pressure for higher long-end yields magically dissipate."

Garvey said that market pricing for a 25-basis-point hike at the September Federal Open Market Committee meeting had shifted from roughly 50-50 to 3-to-1 in favor.

The yield surge is also reshaping portfolio trade-offs for investors.

"More inflation volatility has also tended to increase the correlation between equity and bond markets, reducing the diversification benefits of holding the latter in balanced portfolios," said John Stopford, head of multi-asset income at Ninety One. "Increased real interest rates, however, raise the cost of capital and potentially make bonds a more competitive asset class, especially with equity valuations looking elevated."

Brian Mangwiro, managing director in the global fixed income team at Barings, said government bond funds should be positioned defensively in shorter duration instruments.

"Multi-strategy fixed income funds can also focus on higher income, but, again, with a bias for shorter duration. For the U.S., the sell-off in Treasurys and ongoing curve steepening is also consistent with a weaker US dollar. This is generally bullish for emerging markets."

title: 谢因进入股市时摇摇欲坠。它能恢复魔力吗？
content:
Shein 通过销售低价、实时潮流驱动的服装并将新设计快速推向市场，同时减少库存浪费，建立了其全球快时尚业务。

但推动其快速增长的条件正在发生变化。

这家总部位于新加坡的零售商的股价连续第四天走低，自周二在香港上市以来已下跌 17.5%。

The最初的市场反应将焦点放在 Shein 是否能够重新加速增长，因为推动其崛起的低成本模式面临着越来越大的压力。

分析师表示，Shein 需要证明它不仅可以在价格上进行竞争，将其业务更多地本地化，并在其主要的美国和欧洲市场之外找到新的增长来源。

“我认为这表明他们还有很多工作要做，以向投资者证明这是一家可以持续增长的业务，”说投资平台 eToro 亚太区首席分析师 Josh Gilbert。

Shein 报告称，2025 年收入为 418 亿美元，而上年同期为 387 亿美元。今年第一季度，该公司净亏损 9900 万美元，而上年同期为盈利。

吉尔伯特表示：“美国和欧洲仍然是主要市场，但增长的轻松阶段已经结束。”

这两个市场都收紧了允许低价值进口商品免税的规定。美国于去年 5 月终止了对来自中国和香港的货物的最低限度待遇，而欧盟也在 7 月停止了对价值不超过 150 欧元的低价值进口商品的关税豁免。

欧盟对每件商品征收 3 欧元的临时关税。根据欧盟委员会的数据，到 2025 年，有近 59 亿件低价值商品进入欧盟。

“让 Shein 以几乎免费的价格将一件 5 美元的连衣裙运往半个地球的结构性优势已经消失，”吉尔伯特说。

这些变化给 Shein 带来了更大的挑战，因为它提高了价格。吉尔伯特表示，随着关税推高价格，那些主要为了价格而来到 Shein 的购物者可能会开始比较质量，“这是 Shein 以前从未经历过的一场战斗。”Retail Cities 董事总经理 Bryan Gildenberg 表示，Shein 将技术与能够实时响应的制造商网络相结合的能力仍然是一个优势，但竞争对手正在缩小差距。

“在我看来，这仍然是一种竞争优势，尽管快时尚行业在数字化方面已经处于领先地位。 Gildenberg 告诉 CNBC。

市场情报公司 Euromonitor International 时尚全球高级洞察经理 Marguerite LeRolland 表示，Shein 需要重新定义其价值主张，超越“低价和持续新颖”，包括策划其市场产品和开发服务。

LeRolland 还表示，随着监管机构和公众舆论对公司越来越挑剔，Shein 需要改善其品牌形象。

“业务勒罗兰表示，随着关税和监管要求对 Shein 在美国和欧洲的成本优势造成压力，公司将不得不调整其模式。她补充说，Shein 还需要在亚太地区、中东和非洲以及拉丁美洲扩大规模，以维持全球增长。

但拓展新市场也带来了挑战。虽然吉尔登伯格指出东南亚是一个潜在的增长地区，但他表示，它可能是世界上最具竞争力的电子商务市场之一。

title: 韩国的人工智能集会正在重塑浪漫、真人秀和学术偏好
content:
韩国人工智能股票的上涨正在迅速改变该国社会的各个角落，从爱情到学术。

在韩国的约会领域，医生、律师和法官等专业人士历来是最受欢迎的。现在，人们的偏好正在发生变化，因为人工智能的繁荣使得那些在芯片行业工作的人——拿着高额奖金——成为约会池中的新宝石。

韩国婚介公司Gayeon的发言人表示：“最近，我们发现人们对在SK海力士和三星电子等半导体公司工作的人以及人工智能相关职业的偏好有所增加。”

三星和SK海力士今年早些时候都加入了万亿美元俱乐部今年以来，两家公司的股价分别飙升了约 95% 和约 135%。

巨额奖金为芯片巨头的员工带来了优势。

去年，SK 海力士同意分享其营业利润的 10%，根据路透社的计算，这相当于每名员工约 7 亿韩元，即略高于 50 万美元。这是韩国人去年平均年薪的 15 倍以上。

根据三星的工资协议，存储芯片部门的员工的工资将比 SK 海力士的同事少一些。

在韩国单身人士越来越多地将婚姻视为经济优势的背景下，芯片巨头的员工新崛起。

韩国媒体甚至开始将这种现象称为“婚礼杠杆”，即把两个人结合在一起的想法。收入是支付首付或建立有意义的投资组合的最快方式。

话虽这么说，芯片行业寻找合作伙伴的人越来越挑剔，金融并不总是他们的首选。

“我们从事半导体相关工作的客户现在也倾向于考虑潜在合作伙伴的更广泛因素，而不仅仅是职业或财务，”Gayeon 发言人表示。

芯片巨头受欢迎程度的上升是YouTube 频道 Teo 上的约会节目的灵感来源。三星和 SK 海力士员工相匹配的真人秀节目于 8 月 13 日播出，观看次数约为 65 万次。

“内容旨在关注上班族忙碌的日常生活，利用约会这一相关话题来提供熟悉感和乐趣，”Teo 的发言人表示。 “这个时机也与两家公司在人工智能推动下的繁荣非常吻合，这有助于引起更广泛观众的共鸣。” Netflix 上个月发布了一档名为“新秀金的股市使命”的综艺节目，记录了一位受欢迎的喜剧演员的交易之旅。该节目从喜剧演员购买了 SK 海力士的一些股票开始，引起了韩国散户投资者（占总人口四分之一的群体）的共鸣。

人工智能的热潮甚至正在影响高等教育，这是韩国社会的一个重要成人仪式。在首尔国立大学（即所谓的韩国哈佛大学），电气和计算机工程越来越受欢迎，因为该专业与人工智能相关的工作密切相关。

根据该大学的数据，今年工程学院每 10 名未申报专业的学生中就有 9 名选择学习电气和计算机工程，而根据该大学的数据，2023 年这一比例仅为十分之二。

“韩国学生并不只是将‘人工智能’作为一个抽象概念来追逐。主题——他们正在为三星和 SK 海力士等硬件部门寻找特定的、可见的国内渠道，”Lim 说。她说，与其他职业相比，这些工作为在大公司拥有稳定、固定的职位提供了“更清晰、更直接的回报”。

title: 随着风险投资对估值变得更加挑剔，早期人工智能的“洗牌”可能即将到来
content:
专家表示，投资者应关注人工智能公司生产力的增长，因为某些领域的估值开始显得过高。

风险投资公司 Purple Ventures 的创始合伙人雅库布·尼特拉 (Jakub Nytra) 表示：“随着投资者对技术在何处创造真正价值以及在何处只是伪装成一项业务的要求越来越高，我们可能会看到一场洗牌。”他预计未来 6 到 12 个月资本将变得更加挑剔。

人工智能热潮将继续重塑市场。投资者已将资金投入英伟达以外的半导体公司，押注人工智能数据中心的建设将使更广泛的芯片制造商和基础设施公司受益。尽管如此，对泡沫的担忧仍然存在，因为企业不断增加资本支出，而极高的增长数字引发了人们对扩张可持续性的质疑。

财富管理公司 Arki Finance 联合创始人兼首席执行官 David Ng 表示：“下一个问题是应用程序和最终用户是否能产生足够的生产力、收入和现金流来证明投资的合理性。”财富管理公司 Arki Finance 联合创始人兼首席执行官 David Ng 表示。

虽然人工智能可以改变经济，但并不是每家在其宣传材料中包含人工智能的公司都“值得获得非凡的投资”。估值，”尼特拉说。 “获胜者将是使用人工智能来解决昂贵且高度复杂的问题的公司。”

例如，Nytra 引用了他的投资组合公司之一 TASS Vision 的例子，该公司部署边缘人工智能和摄像头来分析顾客如何在实体店中走动，进而为零售商提供可用于改进的数据。

资产管理公司 Openspace 的创始合伙人 Shane Chesson 表示，即使存在泡沫，最终也应该会带来一些好处。资本。

“如果泡沫确实破裂，那么对那些投资于 FOMO 主导的泡沫的人来说，损失将是最大的，”他说。 “但已经创建的基础设施仍将被使用，并证明对许多公司来说会改变游戏规则。”

title: 印度的互联网繁荣是否遇到了海底问题？
content: Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,Cheap data has helped turn India into one of the world's biggest internet marketsBySoutik BiswasIndia correspondentPublished8 minutes agoOne of India's biggest digital vulnerabilities sits on a six-kilometre stretch of Mumbai's Arabian Sea coast.Around Versova, a densely populated neighbourhood on the city's northwest, at least 13 ofIndia's 18 intercontinental submarine cables,externalcome ashore within six kilometres of one another.Together they carry as much as 95% of India's international bandwidth to Europe, Africa and West Asia."This network faces a critical vulnerability due to severe geographic concentration," says Anwesha Sen of Takshashila Institution, a think tank."If several of those cables were cut simultaneously, either accidentally or deliberately, a bulk of India's westward bandwidth to West Asia, Africa and Europe would be impacted."Cable architecture allows traffic to be rerouted, so a cut would not cause a total blackout.Traffic could be diverted through other landing points, including the southern cities of Chennai and Kochi, say experts. (India's 18 subsea cables land in Mumbai, Chennai, Cochin, Tuticorin, and Trivandrum.)But even performance degradation - small increases in the time it takes data to travel - could be costly for banks, stock exchanges, cloud providers and government networks. AI infrastructure may be particularly sensitive because it relies on high-volume, high-speed data transfers.That vulnerability stems from how much of the world's digital traffic depends on these cables.Image source,Hindustan Times via Getty ImagesImage caption,At least 13 of India's 18 intercontinental cables land within a six-kilometre stretch at Mumbai's Versova beachThey are the internet's hidden highways - bundles of optical fibres on the ocean floor carrying data between continents as pulses of light. Humans have laid some 870,000 miles (1.4 million km) of them, "lacing the Earth tightly together", writes Samanth Subramanian in his new book The Web Beneath the Waves. These cables carry about 99% of global communication traffic.Cheap data has helped make India one of the world's biggest internet markets. By late 2025, it hadmore than a billion broadband subscribers,external. India's growing digital economy and services sector increasingly depend on these cables.But India's growing reliance on this invisible infrastructure sits uneasily with how little of it the country actually has.India accounts for roughly 20% of global consumption of data, but is connected to only about 3% of the world's submarine cables.It has 21 cable landing stations - coastal gateways where undersea cables connect to terrestrial networks - compared with roughly 1,900 planned and active globally, giving India about 1% of the world's total, according to the Broadband India Forum (BIF)."We need to grow the number of cable landing stations several fold," says Aruna Sundararajan, chairperson of BIF.Experts believe this is the paradox at the heart of India's digital transformation: the country is becoming an internet and data-centre powerhouse without controlling enough of the physical infrastructure that connects it to the world.Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,Technicians work at a western India factory making fibre-optic strands for data centres powering the global AI boomA recent paper by Takshashila Instituition finds that 11 of India's 18 international cables are more than 20 years old, approaching the nominal 25-year operating life of submarine cable systems."It's true that a significant share of India's landing cables are approaching economic end-of-life, and that is a legitimate area of focus," says Amajit Gupta, group CEO and managing director of Lightstorm, a digital infrastructure company.And then there are cable faults - a far more common risk than deliberate attacks.Globally, there are anestimated 150-200 cable faults a year,external, most caused not by saboteurs but by fishing, ship anchors, natural hazards and equipment failure."We've seen a version of this scenario play out with theRed Sea disruptions,external," Gupta said, when traffic was rerouted east through Singapore and onward to the US.And when an undersea cable breaks, India has another striking weakness: it has no domestic subsea cable-repair ships.Repair ships have to come from abroad and obtain permission to operate in Indian waters."Every cable fault in Indian waters depends on foreign repair ships from Dubai or Singapore. Once a foreign ship is assigned, it must obtain licences to operate in Indian waters, adding weeks to an already lengthy process," says Sen.That dependence on foreign repair capacity is the more fundamental weakness."The bigger structural issue for India isn't rerouting capability - it's repair capacity," says Gupta."That combination â dependence on foreign repair capacity and regulatory lead times â represents the real bottleneck," he says.Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,A high-speed submarine cable linking Singapore to France being installed in southern FranceBut repair is only one part of the challenge.Gupta believes the question isn't whether India is retiring old cables, but whether new terrestrial and subsea capacity can keep pace with AI-driven demand. "The industry cannot afford to catch up; it must stay ahead," he says.That demand is also fuelling a rapid build-out of data centres - the computing hubs where data is stored and AI models are trained and run. They too depend on fast, reliable links to global cloud and internet networks.Governmentfigures,externalshow installed data-centre capacity has risen from 375MW in 2020 to about 1,575MW today.That creates a potential mismatch."Subsea cable planning itself takes three-four years and then cable laying also takes up to two years depending upon cable length," says Sundararajan. "Thus, there can be some lag in getting subsea cable capacity to feed the upcoming data-centre capacity."The bigger hurdle may be India's bureaucracy.Sundararajan says 16 agencies across telecoms, defence, home affairs, shipping, ports, environment and state authorities are involved in clearing the construction, operation and repair of subsea cables.Setting up a cable landing station alone can require around 50 clearances across at least 16 ministries, she says. "A core issue is fragmented governance, not a lack of technical capability."She wants India's Department of Telecommunications to be the main agency, with a single-window system to speed up repair-vessel permits.Sundararajan says the government should pre-identify and pre-approve multiple cable landing sites on both coasts and in island territories with standard conditions so cable companies do not have to start the approval process from scratch.To become a genuine regional cable hub, she says, India needs "predictable regulation, open infrastructure and rapid repair mechanisms" - the kind of environment that has helped Singapore attract cables and data traffic.Image source,AFP via Getty ImagesImage caption,Some 870,000 miles of optical fibres on the ocean floors carry about 99% of global communication trafficPooja Bhatt, an associate professor at OP Jindal Global University, says that mismatch is increasingly difficult to ignore."Given its young demographics and 'Digital India' aspirations, it makes sense for the nation to build and maintain its own internet infrastructure for security and governance purposes," she says.India has already taken a step: the government now treats submarine cable systems as critical telecommunications infrastructure, recognising their importance to international connectivity.Sundararajan says the designation should bring faster clearances, emergency repair mechanisms and an Indian cable-repair capability, along with legally protected cable zones around landing sites and routes, restricting anchoring and trawling.Technology could help too.A technology called Distributed Acoustic Sensing can turn optical fibres into sensors capable of detecting vibrations from ships, anchors or underwater vehicles â potentially identifying threats before a cable is severed.But the immediate fixes are possibly more mundane: more landing stations, greater geographical diversity, faster permissions, protected cable routes and an Indian repair capability."Connectivity has historically clustered around Mumbai because the ecosystem, infrastructure and demand were already concentrated there," Gupta says. "But that concentration is exactly the risk the industry needs to design away from."That shift is already beginning.Four new submarine cable systems are beingcommissioned,external, with three more planned. Lightstorm is leading a consortium building one of them, I-2SEA, linking India with Malaysia and Singapore. The system will have dual landings in India â at Machilipatnam, providing a shorter subsea route to Hyderabad, and at a new landing location in South Chennai, adding diversity to existing routes.For a country consuming data at extraordinary speed, the infrastructure carrying it remains surprisingly fragile. India is adding data centres and preparing for an AI-heavy future. The question is whether its cables, landing stations and repair capacity can keep up.Related topicsIndiaInternetAsiaMumbaiTelecommunication

title: 随着供应商未付燃料的诉讼升温，特朗普推动的自由燃料公司扩展到底特律
content:
自由燃料网络 (The Freedom Fuel Network) 是一家加油站连锁店，于 7 月份推出，受到唐纳德·特朗普总统的大力宣传，价格大幅折扣，随着费城联邦法院对该连锁店涉嫌供应的诉讼不断升温，该加油站已在底特律开设了新分店。

底特律分店提供的汽油是密歇根州最便宜的，每加仑普通无铅汽油售价为 4.09 美元。加仑，根据价格跟踪网站GasBuddy。哈珀大道加油站是新泽西州和宾夕法尼亚州以外的第一个自由加油站，该网络在这两个州共有 29 个加油站。

GasBuddy 数据显示，自由加油站不再是这些州最便宜的加油站。

在本周的一份法庭文件中，佐治亚州一家燃油供应商声称，商人赛义德·卡兹米 (Syed Kazmi) 及其公司 KRSM（据称该公司将从该供应商处购买的部分燃油出售给自由加油站）由于 KRSM 据称未能支付燃料费用而提起诉讼，该公司未能在 M&T 银行支票账户中保持至少 275 万美元的余额，从而违反了法官 8 月 28 日的命令。

在周四的一份新法庭文件中，供应商盖恩斯维尔的曼斯菲尔德石油公司 (Mansfield Oil Co.) 告诉法官，该账户资金不足约 225 万美元。

该文件还称，曼斯菲尔德石油公司从 M&T 获悉，与 KRSM 声称拥有该账户的说法相反，该账户“现在属于某个名为‘Universal’的与 Kazmi 相关的不同实体。”

“该账户现在由‘Universal’拥有的消息也引起了人们的严重担忧，即资金正在被消耗，而 KRSM 未能维持法院命令的 275 万美元金额，”曼斯菲尔德在

Freedom Fuel 不是该诉讼的被告，其指控是在人们质疑 Freedom Fuel 如何在伊朗战争造成的供应限制和燃油价格上涨的情况下提供大幅折扣的价格。

Mansfield 于 8 月 19 日提起诉讼，声称 Kazmi 和 KRSM 在 5 月至 7 月期间从宾夕法尼亚州的一个供应终端获得了超过 110 万加仑的 Mansfield 燃料。

之后诉讼称，曼斯菲尔德在 7 月份发出了一张发票，要求支付约 400 万美元的燃料费用，而 KRSM 未能支付。

诉讼称，至少有一些燃料被出售给了自由加油站，该加油站于 7 月初开始在宾夕法尼亚州和新泽西州运营。民事诉讼并未说明曼斯菲尔德的燃油最终流入了这些加油站。

诉讼称：“KRSM 之所以能够以如此低的价格出售此类燃油并获得如此高的知名度，是因为它从未向原告支付此类燃油费用。”

Politico 报道称，Kazmi 的兄弟 Shamikh Kazmi 在新泽西州拥有至少 6 个 Freedom Fuel 加油站。

CNBC 已要求对法庭发表评论KRSM、Syed Kazmi、Mansfield Oil 和 Freedom Fuel Network 的律师提交的文件。

KRSM 的律师 Mauro Tucci 在 8 月 30 日的一封电子邮件中向 CNBC 表示，“KRSM 对本案中的指控提出异议，这是关于 Mansfield Oil 错误定价的燃油发票的会计纠纷。”

“我们不会对这起未决诉讼进一步发表评论，”Tucci周四，Freedom Fuel 在其网站上宣布设立底特律加油站时表示，“由于该网络取得了巨大成功，储蓄社区也看到了加油站的情况，我们听到了你们的声音，我们正在进一步扩张。”Freedom Fuel 表示。

特朗普于 7 月 1 日发布了有关 Freedom Fuel 及其较低价格的信息，他说其他零售商应该效仿。

“继总统之后，我们收到了媒体对 Freedom Fuel Network 的巨大兴趣。该网站称，特朗普对 Freedom Fuel 加油站的大力支持。

“尽管存在错误信息和毫无根据的猜测，但让我们澄清事实：Freedom Fuel Network 正在自豪地降低价格，以造福我们的社区并加强我们当地的经济。”

“就像总统一样，我们仍然致力于美国优先！上帝保佑美国。”

— CNBC 的瑞安Ermey 对本文做出了贡献

title: Zscaler stock rises on earnings beat, upbeat guidance
content:
由于不断上升的人工智能风险刺激了对网络工具的迫切需求，云安全公司 Zscaler 的股票周四飙升，该公司的第四季度财报超出了华尔街的预期。

该公司的表现与 LSEG 的预期相比如下：

收入比去年的约 7.19 亿美元增长了 25%。 Zscaler 报告净亏损 340 万美元，每股亏损 2 美分，高于一年前净亏损 1760 万美元，每股亏损 11 美分。

首席执行官 Jay Chaudhry 强调，公司零信任云安全架构和创新技术的采用是季度业绩背后的驱动力。

他告诉 CNBC，他“非常看好”最近推出的人工智能零信任迭代。 Chaudhry 表示：“这是一个长期机遇，但我认为这是一个极好的机会，但进入壁垒很高。”。

年度经常性收入比一年前增长 25%，达到 37.7 亿美元，超出了 37.5 亿美元的预期StreetAccount。

随着日益复杂的网络模型和代理主导的攻击的兴起，迫使企业采用新的安全工具，网络安全股票今年飙升。

虽然竞争对手今年创下新高，但 Zscaler 股价却暴跌 20%。上个季度，该股经历了有史以来最糟糕的一天，因为管理层在两名销售主管离职后采取了“谨慎的方法”来指导。

但 Chaudhry 表示，市场没有抓住 Zscaler 差异化竞争的重点。

“我们带来的核心能力非常独特，随着人工智能代理的采用，市场将越来越认识到 Zscaler 是一个关键参与者，”他说。

与其他网络公司一样。乔杜里（Chaudhry）高管将人工智能的安全视为最大的机遇之一。去年，预订总额达 1 亿美元，本季度环比增长超过 50%。

Zscaler 的指导也超出了预期。该公司预计第一财季营收为 9.35 亿美元至 9.39 亿美元，调整后每股收益为 1.15 美元至 1.16 美元。这超过了 9.27 亿美元的收入预期和每股 1.08 美元的调整后每股收益。

公司预计全年收入在 39.1 亿美元至 39.4 亿美元之间，高于 39 亿美元的预期。调整后每股收益预计在 4.86 美元至 4.90 美元之间，超出每股 4.60 美元的预期。

title: 随着罗宾汉和特斯拉的飙升，期权交易量在零售交易中激增
content:
九月份的季节性低迷就到此为止了。

期权交易员通过对少数以大幅波动和投机活动而闻名的零售交易热门股票进行看涨押注，开始了股票历史上最糟糕的一个月。

周四，Robinhood Markets、Palantir Technologies 和 Elon Muskgiants Tesla 和 SpaceX 等股票的交易量高于平均水平，这些股票是顶级和 SpaceX 的股票。按期权交易量计算，交易量分别排名第四。

交易流量看起来明显看涨，看涨期权的交易量超过看跌期权的交易量至少为 2 比 1。虽然每个名字都有一个特定股票的故事，但随着芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数 (VIX) 交易低于 15，交易者也可能会利用标准普尔 500 指数和个股隐含波动率的急剧下降。

零售交易者最喜欢的、飙升的交易平台股票 Robinhood 在周四的交易中看到了这四个名字中最明显的看涨行为。截至中午，看涨期权的交易量是看跌期权的两倍多，看涨期权的买入量是看跌期权的近三倍。看跌期权的卖出量也超过了看跌期权的买入量，这表明交易员对日均交易量超过三倍的信心十足的看涨情绪。

Robinhood 股票在周四大幅上涨后的一年里突然表现积极，距离今年迄今的新高也很近。

Palantir 股票同样大幅上涨也转化为期权活动的增加。该软件股票跻身交易量最大的十大单一股票期权之列，其日交易量几乎是日均交易量的两倍。交易员购买的看涨期权数量是看跌期权的两倍，卖出的看跌期权多于买入的看跌期权。

但这一切都与今晚在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的 Tesla Cyber​​cab 活动之前马斯克的狂热有关。 Tesla 和 SpaceX 的交易员购买的看涨期权数量是看跌期权的两倍，卖出的看跌期权明显多于买入的看跌期权。

SpaceX 的行动正值该股重新回到 150 美元的关键水平之际，该价格自 7 月初以来从未收于上方。与此同时，波动性也大幅下降。 SpaceX 目前的 30 天隐含波动率仅为第 4 个百分位，约为 6 月 12 日上市以来历史平均水平的一半。

Prosper Trading Academy 动量交易专家 Charles Moon 表示：“比特币价格上涨对 Robinhood 来说非常有利，而 Snowflake 则是 Palantir 的催化剂。” “零售业变得越来越激进，因为他们所需要的只是一个这样做的理由。这是一个好兆头。”

title: OpenAI 在对其先进的网络功能发出警告后开始推出 Astra 模型
content:
OpenAIon 周四宣布将开始推出其最新的人工智能模型 GPT-6 Astra，该公司称该模型是“多年研究和大赌注”的产物。

该模型正在分阶段推出，OpenAI 表示，参与其基于应用程序的网络安全计划 Daybreak 的少数公司将率先获得访问权限。 OpenAI 本周早些时候透露，Astra 是其第一个达到“关键”内部网络安全阈值的模型，并表示计划限制对这些高级功能的访问。

在上个月其两个模型逃脱围堵、访问开放网络并破坏 Hugging Face 的系统后，OpenAI 一直面临着加强其安全防护的压力。

事件发生后，该公司暂时暂停了一些研究和培训工作，包括针对 Astra 的研究和培训工作，甚至包括针对 Astra 的研究和培训工作。 OpenAI 总裁格雷格·布罗克曼 (Greg Brockman) 在周四向记者举行的新闻发布会上表示：“只有当安全成为人工智能的核心部分时，人工智能才能使人们受益，因此我们比以往任何时候都投入更多的计算和精力来保障安全、保障和一致性。”

该公司在 Hugging Face 泄露事件后为 Astra 增加了额外的保护措施，并于周二表示，它相信这些保护措施“足以将严重伤害的风险降到最低”。 OpenAI 表示，Astra 将在“未来几天”通过 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 计划以及 OpenAI API 和 Amazon Web Services 向用户推出。

OpenAI 表示，除了先进的网络安全功能外，Astra 在计算机使用、软件工程、专业工作和科学等功能方面也处于领先地位。根据发布的信息，该模型还能够更好地保持导向、尊重任务边界、理解用户意图、完成繁琐的任务以及执行多步骤工作流程。

“还有很多工作要做，我认为还有很多改进需要进行，但这里有一些重要的东西我认为是质的改进，对我来说，这就是人们可以将哪些工作委托给人工智能以及人工智能如何赋予他们权力方面的重大和真正的转变，”布罗克曼

去年，OpenAI 花了很多时间在竞争激烈的企业市场上吸引企业客户，并与包括 Anthropic 和 Google 在内的竞争对手展开竞争。

首席财务官 Sarah Friar 上个月告诉员工，正如 CNBC 之前报道的那样，其企业部门的收入现在超过了消费者业务，这使其成为一个重要的收入引擎，因为它正在为人们普遍预期的重磅 IPO 做好准备。

该公司秘密地透露。 6月份向美国证券交易委员会提交了招股说明书，但尚未正式披露计划上市时间。 Friar 最近告诉员工，OpenAI“将在 2027 年成为一家上市公司”，但表示如果“我们的业务继续发生变化”，该公司可能会更快退出。

title: ChargePoint CEO says 70% stock surge 'is the beginning of the momentum'
content:
ChargePoint HoldingsCEO Rick Wilmer believes a surge in the electric vehicle charging company's stock Thursday is just "the beginning of the momentum," he told CNBC.

Shares of ChargePoint increased more than 70% during afternoon trading after the company significantly beat Wall Street's second-quarter expectations for its 2027 fiscal year and guided toward continued improvements in its performance.

It's the most notable increase since it underwent a reverse stock split last year to raise its share price and maintain compliance with the New York Stock Exchange's minimum trading price requirement of $1 per share.

"The growth is starting to accelerate," Wilmer told CNBC during an interview Thursday morning. "It'll be driven substantially by the new products and technology we're putting into the market."

ChargePoint, unlike some EV charging companies, does not actually own and operate its chargers. It provides hardware, software and services to customers, such as businesses, that want to offer chargers to their employees or customers.

The company after markets closed Wednesday reported revenue of $116.1 million and a loss per share of 35 cents during the quarter. That compared with analyst expectations of $105.2 million in revenue and a loss of 85 cents, according to average estimates compiled by LSEG.

Its performance was assisted by a one-time tariff refund of approximately $4.2 million in the quarter, but the company said its normalized gross margin would have still set a new record without the benefit.

"We've now had our fourth consecutive quarter of year-over-year growth, and this quarter we just reported yesterday was obviously another good growth quarter," Wilmer said. "And now [we're] expecting that to accelerate, especially as we move into next year."

As part of its growth plan, the company has been introducing faster high-performance chargers, known as "Level 3," in Europe, as well as next-generation products for the U.S., including Level 2 and Level 3 chargers.

The company also is using artificial intelligence to improve charging times for its customers, reduce how long it takes to develop software and improve efficiency across its business, Wilmer said.

Wilmer's optimism comes despite aslowdown in all-electric vehicle salesduring the past year, following the elimination of federal support for the industry in the U.S., including the end of an up to $7,500consumer benefitfor purchasing an EV.

"I think, altogether, the down cycle, or the doom and gloom, has been a bit overstated. I think there's a lot more positivity at the ground level," Wilmer said. "I just think in the end, better products can win."

U.S. automakers are continuing to sell EVs, and demand in theused vehicle marketis strong amid high gas prices, but the move to non-gas-powered vehicles has been significantly lower than many companies and analysts previously expected.

ChargePoint is toward the end of a three-year business plan spearheaded by Wilmer that focused on reducing cash burn and profits, including cutting net losses from $125.3 million three years ago to $35.6 million during its most recent quarter.

The company has not disclosed when it plans to be profitable, but Wilmer said the company is on its way to achieve a profit on an earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization basis.

"We're approaching that quickly, and we want to get there ASAP," he said Thursday.

ChargePoint's third-quarter guidance for its 2027 fiscal year included revenue between $105 million and $115 million, which would be a mid-point increase of roughly 4% year-over-year.

title: Elon Musk starts spending his midterm election millions, revealing his key Senate targets
content:
Elon Musk'ssuper PAC is putting its first midterm money behind some of theGOP'smost important election battlegrounds, spending more than $800,000 across seven Senate races and a handful of competitive House districts, according to a new Federal Election Commissiondisclosure.

The spending byAmerica PACoffers the clearest look yet at where theTeslaandSpaceXCEO is directing his political operation, after the billionaire who previously supported Democrats reportedly authorized the group to spend as much as $120 million on an effort to help elect Republicans this November.

Nearly 90% of the $800,475 disclosed Wednesday night went toward Senate races, with the largest share — more than $247,000 — spent inTexasto support Republican Attorney GeneralKen Paxtonand oppose DemocratJames Talaricoin an increasingly competitive contest.

Paxton has struggled to keep pace with Talarico's spending. As of Aug. 20, Talarico's campaign had spent more than $25 million on advertising since the general election began in late May, compared with just $119,000 by Paxton's campaign, according to AdImpact data cited by theTexas Tribune.

America PAC had been increasingly targeting Talarico on social media before the newly disclosed expenditures.

The group also spent about $170,000 inMaine, where Republican Sen.Susan Collinsis seeking reelection, and nearly $106,000 in Ohio to support Republican Sen.Jon Husted. The PAC disclosed another $91,459 inNew Hampshire, $54,600 inIowa, $25,605 in Michigan and $17,235 in Alaska.

The expenditures were made between Aug. 18 and Aug. 31, with the disclosure also listing two expenditures scheduled for Sept. 10. All were categorized as printing expenses, indicating the money was being used for mail advertising.

America PAC spent much less on House races, which are usually cheaper than statewide races, directing nearly $90,000 across eight contests. The spending benefited Republican Reps. Derrick Van Orden ofWisconsin,Mike Lawlerof New York,Jen KiggansofVirginia,Tom Kean Jr. of New Jersey, andScott Perry,Rob Bresnahanand Ryan Mackenzie ofPennsylvania, as well as Republican Scott Singer, who is challenging Democratic Rep.Jared Moskowitzin Florida.

The spending was disclosed days after House SpeakerMike Johnson, R-La.,reportedlymet with Musk in Texas while campaigning for Republicans in competitive congressional races. Johnson later told House Republican leaders about the meeting but did not say whether Musk had made any commitments about midterm spending.

"He's made public a lot of what he's doing," Johnson said toCBS Newswhen asked about Musk's plans. "I'm not going to talk about our conversation on that point, but we're going to win the midterms."

Johnson did not immediately respond to a request for comment from CNBC.

Musk spent hundreds of millions of dollars supporting PresidentDonald Trumpand other Republican candidates in2024, including more than $239 million given to America PAC. But he later appeared ready to retreat from that level of political involvement after joining the Trump administration to lead theDepartment of Government Efficiency, then having a public falling out with the president.

Asked last year whether he intended to continue spending at the same pace, Musk said he planned tospend "a lot less"on politics.

"I think I've done enough," Musk said.

But Musk has since repaired his relationship with Trump and Republican leaders. The New York Timesreportedin July that Musk had authorized America PAC to spend up to $120 million on a field program aimed at electing Republicans this November.

The latest expenditures are still just a fraction of that potential commitment.

They also come before America PAC has disclosed the latest influx ofmoney financing its midterm push. FEC data covering the 2025-26 election cycle through June 30 show America PAC had raised $50.3 million and spent $52.3 million, leaving it with about$274,000 in cash on hand.

title: Automakers urge Congress to permanently ban Chinese connected vehicles in U.S.
content:
DETROIT — Major automakers operating in the U.S. are increasing pressure on Congress to permanently ban the domestic sale, import and manufacturing of Chinese connected vehicles, hardware and software.

The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, which represents the vast majority of companies selling vehicles in the U.S., urged congressional leaders in a Thursday letter to make a move before the end of Congress' current session on Jan. 3.

"Right now, Chinese automakers are dumping subsidized vehicles with connected software and hardware around the world," John Bozzella, CEO of the group, said in the letter seen by CNBC. "This hasn't happened inside the U.S. yet, but given the scale and urgency of this threat, we urge you to enact a Chinese vehicle, software and hardware ban before adjourning this year and make this policy the law of the land."

Midterm elections are also coming up in November, which could affect Congress' momentum.

Bozzella's comments come amid bipartisan efforts in the House and Senate to address Chinese vehicles, includinglegislationadvanced by the Senate Commerce Committee that could ban Mercedes-Benz in the U.S. because Chinese investorshold nearly 20% of the German automaker.

The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, which includes Mercedes-Benz, said in the Thursday letter that it wants to work with lawmakers to "achieve a balanced policy so all our member companies continue to succeed and thrive inside the U.S."

Automakers have been worried that Chinese rivals like BYD and Geely are flooding global markets, undercutting domestic production and vehicle prices. Those Chinese-based companies have been increasing their vehicle exports to Europe and Central and South America.

"Enacting a permanent ban on Chinese vehicles and high-risk hardware and software in the 119th Congress will send a clear and bipartisan message that China's strategy to dominate global automotive manufacturing will be met with a national security policy response from the American government," Bozzella said.

title: Nvidia 斥资 129 亿美元收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face
content: 图片来源，盖蒂图片社 图片说明，英伟达将通过这笔交易获得世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一。商业记者弗朗西斯科·维拉斯克斯 (Francisco Velasquez) 报道，来自纽约的报道发布于 2026 年 9 月 3 日，英国夏令时 17:01 于 39 分钟前更新 英伟达已同意以约 129 亿美元（合 95 亿英镑）的交易收购人工智能平台 Hugging Face，该公司是该人工智能芯片制造商之一Hugging Face 成立于 2016 年，已成为一个流行的在线平台，开发人员和研究人员可以在其中查找、共享和测试 AI 模型和工具。最近，在其平台上出现了逃离测试环境的流氓 AI 代理后，该平台成为头条新闻，引发了有关 AI 安全和监督的问题。这笔交易将把世界上最大的 AI 开发者社区之一引入 Nvidia，并使其控制领先的开源平台 - 这是 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 提供的系统的替代方案。Nvidia 是以制造用于训练和运行人工智能系统的先进芯片而闻名。随着各公司竞相打造人工智能产品，对这些芯片的需求激增。两家公司已经合作，帮助开发者通过该平台使用 Nvidia 的计算服务。据公司称，Hugging Face 已被超过 1800 万开发者使用，并托管了超过 300 万个 AI 模型。他们表示，超过 20 万家公司使用该平台。英伟达表示，Hugging Face 将继续向开发者开放，用户不会被要求使用其芯片或服务。英伟达股价截至英国夏令时 17:30 上涨略低于 1.5%。根据协议，英伟达将向 Hugging Face 投资者支付约 119 亿美元，并向加入该公司的员工提供高达 10 亿美元的股票激励。该交易还可以帮助英伟达扩大其在人工智能软件领域的影响力因为包括微软、Meta 和 OpenAI 在内的一些最大客户都在开发自己的芯片。开源人工智能模型可以由用户下载和调整，这与许多由单一公司控制的人工智能系统不同。支持者表示，这种方法可以使企业、研究人员和开发人员更容易使用该技术。倡导组织消费者选择中心副主任 Ya?l Ossowski 表示，此次收购是“对开放人工智能的信任票”，并表示它可以通过让人工智能工具更广泛地向初创企业和小型企业提供来鼓励竞争。他补充说，如果英伟达保持 Hugging Face 的开放性和可访问性，这笔交易将是“全球创新者和消费者的重大胜利”。随着该领域竞争的加剧，这笔交易还将让英伟达进入世界上最大的人工智能开发者社区之一。Hugging Face 由法国企业家 Clément Delangue、Julien Chaumond 和 Thomas Wolf 创立，还提供用于构建人工智能应用程序的数据集、软件工具和云服务。Hugging Face 得到了包括亚马逊、AMD 和英特尔。相关主题人工智能更多关于这个故事OpenAI 代理之间的意外聊天导致 Hugging Face 黑客攻击发布于 8 月 26 日 Nvidia 收入因持续的人工智能需求而翻倍发布于 8 月 26 日

title: Carney claps back at Lutnick, says Canada will resume trade talks 'when the Americans are ready'
content:
加拿大总理马克·卡尼恩 (Mark Carneyon) 周四在特朗普政府商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 声称渥太华出于政治目的而破坏与美国的贸易谈判后进行了反击。

卡尼在安大略省西北部桑德贝举行的新闻发布会上表示，“恕我直言，我不认为美国任命的、未经选举产生的内阁成员是加拿大政治的专家。”

“我们将永远支持加拿大的政治。”什么最符合加拿大的利益，”卡尼指责美国在谈判已被取消的情况下对贸易协议的红线提出了不同的主张。

但总理坚称达成一项对加拿大和美国都有利的协议是可能的。他说：“当美国人准备好时，我们就准备坐下来达成这项协议。”

总统唐纳德·特朗普莱特周四早上似乎不太愿意重新点燃美国和加拿大的冷淡关系。

“对于像卡尼总理这样的加拿大政客来说，让唐纳德·J·特朗普总统成为‘敌人’，直到他们的经济崩溃，这是非常好的，”特朗普在《真相社会》帖子中写道。 “那么这对政治来说将是非常糟糕的——比加拿大政治家所经历过的任何事情都更糟糕。看吧！”

卡尼一天前在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”节目中回应了卢特尼克的说法，即加拿大人“仅出于政治原因”“毁掉了”与美国近乎完整的贸易协议。

加拿大“不尊重”唐纳德·特朗普总统，但他们Lutnick 断言，“他们的选举将在 10 月中旬之后改变”。

加拿大即将在少数几个选区或议会选区举行特别选举或补选。

谈判代表未能在特朗普 8 月 22 日最后期限前达成协议，对价值约 200 亿美元的加拿大产品加征 50% 的关税，因此上个月退出了贸易谈判。

加拿大对美国商品征收“一美元对一美元”的关税进行报复，该关税定于下周生效。

双方都指责对方在最后一刻提出了不合理的要求。卢特尼克周三表示，就在特朗普关税截止日期前几个小时，加拿大试图对中型和重型卡车增加关税减免。美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔此前否认了卡尼关于加拿大法语要求是贸易谈判中的一个症结点的说法。

卡尼在周四的言论中进行了反驳。 “直到最后一小时，美国还在争论一些问题。红线不会改变……‘我们的道路或高速公路，接受或离开’，你知道，态度。”

“突然之间，他们不再关心加拿大的语言或文化以及这些元素，”卡尼说，并补充道，“很好。我们欢迎这一点。我们关心这些问题。”

在卡车争端上，卡尼指责美国在其要求上出尔反尔。

“他们的反应是，‘当然，我们不会将他们拒之门外。’”好吧，他们会把他们拒之门外，”他说。 “他们现在所说的一些内容与他们之前划定的界限不同。”

title: 家庭警告天然气价格飙升可能给能源账单带来新的压力
content: Image source,Getty ImagesByArchie MitchellBusiness reporterPublished5 minutes agoHouseholds across the UK are being warned to brace for higher energy bills this winter as European countries scramble to replenish their natural gas stores before the weather dips.Wholesale natural gas prices are already at three-year highs, which could lead to increased energy bills for businesses and consumers.Europe, which delayed its summer stockpiling due to high wholesale costs sparked by the Iran war, had been gambling the conflict would end before winter and prices would in turn fall.Storage levels are significantly lower than usual for this time of year, with countries facing the prospect of rushing to buy gas now or paying potentially higher prices when the winter comes.The European benchmark natural gas price topped â¬75/MWh on Wednesday, its highest levelsince late 2022, the tail end of a spike caused by Russia's invasion of Ukraine. Natural gas prices in the UK this week topped 185p per therm, also the highest since late 2022.The price has jumped in the past week amid a return to hostilities between the US and Iran, with analysts fearing the renewed fighting will keep thekey Strait of Hormuzclosed even longer. Typically, around a fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) is transported through the waterway.Hamad Hussain, senior climate and commodities economist at Capital Economics, said he did not expect the waterway to begin reopening until early 2027.Even then, there will be a lag before energy is flowing freely through the strait and pressure on energy prices are eased."The risks to gas prices are definitely tilted towards the upside," Hussain told the BBC, warning that the gas price would top â¬80 by the end of this year.Hussain recalled interviews with gas storage operators at the outbreak of the US-Israeli war in Iran saying they would wait three to four months for the crisis to ease before stocking up."We are about six months into the strait being effectively closed and that obviously has not happened," he added.Higher wholesale gas prices feed through to household energy bills by helping determine regulator Ofgem's price cap.The energy price cap rose in July, and willincrease by 4% in October, leaving a typical household paying Â£1,723. But analysts at the energy consultancy Cornwall Insight have forecast domestic energy prices could rise a further 9% in the new year, bringing renewed concern to households during the coldest months.Dr Craig Lowrey, principal consultant at Cornwall Insight, told the BBC on Thursday a fresh increase in wholesale prices would "increase pressure on our January price cap forecast".However, he cautioned that there was "plenty of time to go" and a fall in wholesale prices could ease the pressure.The Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (Desnz) said gas prices are determined on international markets, dismissing criticism of the UK's own low levels of storage.The boss of British Gas owner Centrica, Chris O'Shea, hasrepeatedly calledfor support from the government to expand its Rough storage facility in the North Sea, warning it has been unviable to fill it up and that it will close next year without a deal."We have almost no gas in storage in the UK for the coming winter and this is a huge concern as energy security is national security," hesaid on LinkedIn,externallast week.A Desnz spokesman said: "We remain open to discussing proposals on all gas storage sites, as long as it provides value for money for taxpayers."The department also pointed to Prime Minister Andy Burnham's pledge to cut VAT from energy bills from October, as well as government action to reduce Britain's reliance on natural gas altogether.Ãngel Talavera, chief European economist at Oxford Economics, said there is a "glass half full, and a glass half empty" picture unfolding.On one hand, wholesale gas prices are significantly lower than during the crisis which followed Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.On the other, households and businesses will still face significantly higher energy bills than usual over the coming months."It's serious, but not catastrophic," he told the BBC, adding "something would have to dramatically change to lower prices".He pointed to a reduction in demand for natural gas in general as a result of the shift towards renewables, but said the overall picture depends hugely on the winter weather."If you have a warmer winter than average, that will be great for demand," he said. But he warned a colder than average winter would have the opposite effect, driving up demand for energy and pushing up prices.It is not known how thedeveloping El NiÃ±o over the Pacific Oceanwill impact Britain's winter. The so-called Big Freeze of winter 2009-10 was, at the time, the coldest in three decades - and this coincided with an El NiÃ±o.However, 2006-07 was also an El NiÃ±o winter and that was unseasonably warm.Talavera said gas prices could come down if the weather helps reduce demand and the Strait of Hormuz reopens sooner than expected.But, at the moment, "the weather machine remains our main hope".It comes as a recent spike in the UK government's borrowing costs eased. After a sharp uptick on Tuesday, which took the yield on a 10-year bond - or gilt - to the highest level since 2008, it fell back slightly on Thursday.Yields are hovering around 5.15%, however, which would still represent a post-2008 peak were it not for Tuesday's jump.Related topicsCost of LivingOfgem

title: Hugging Face 首席执行官告诉 CNBC，Hugging Face 在 12.9B 美元收购前几周就与 Nvidia 接洽
content:
Nvidia 已正式同意以 129 亿美元收购开源人工智能平台 Hugging Face，这家芯片制造商将超越硬件，进一步向 AI 堆栈的高端迈进。

自上周 The Information 报道以来，人们就预计该交易完成后，Hugging Face 将“仍然是整个人工智能生态系统的开放平台”，Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 在周四的博文中写道。

“我们将共同扩大规模” Hugging Face 的平台，加强其基础设施，并为全世界的开发者和机构扩大对人工智能的访问。”Hugging Face 首席执行官 Clément Delangue 周四告诉 CNBC，该公司在夏天与 Huang 就一项交易进行了接触，“几周后，我们就到了。”

“在夏天，我认为我们意识到 Hugging Face 和开源人工智能总体上正处于转折点，它需要更多、更多的资源、更大的规模、更多的资源。”他在“Squawk Box”节目中对 CNBC 的 Becky Quick 表示。

Delangue 表示，他首先接触 Nvidia 是因为 Nvidia 对他的公司来说是“完美的家”，并补充说，讨论速度相当快，最终达成了交易。

此次收购标志着 Nvidia 继去年 12 月以 200 亿美元收购芯片制造商 Groq 的资产后，创下了有记录以来的第二大收购。在此之前，其最大的一笔交易是 2019 年以近 70 亿美元收购以色列芯片制造商 Mellanox。

由于对其图形处理单元的永不满足的需求，Nvidia 已成为世界上最有价值的公司，而图形处理单元推动了生成式 AI 的繁荣。 Hugging Face 标志着对流行人工智能平台的一次大赌注，因为 Nvidia 继续表明自己不仅仅是一家芯片公司。

Hugging Face 最近成为黑客事件的中心，这引发了人们对强大人工智能和网络安全工具快速发展的担忧。

开源模型的支持者 Delangue 将最近对 Hugging Face 的攻击归咎于工程错误，并表示他的公司使用了中国开放模型的 Nvidia 版本来解决问题

Clement 周四向 CNBC 表示，此次泄露事件证明了开放模型的重要性，以及他的公司需要“加倍努力”推动开源人工智能的扩散。

黄说，开源环境可以为防御者提供相对于攻击者的“不对称优势”。

“当我说不对称能力时，保护的人比攻击的人多得多，”他解释道。 “因此，让社区以开放模式聚集在一起，以便他们能够相互透明地合作，这给防御者带来了不对称的优势。”

title: 美联储理事沃勒表示他将支持在 9 月会议上保持利率稳定
content:
美联储理事克里斯托弗·沃勒周四表示，如果即将到来的通胀数据不会出现意外，他倾向于在央行 9 月会议上保持利率稳定。

沃勒的言论似乎与主席凯文·沃什上周的声明形成鲜明对比，沃勒表达了对当前通胀趋势的信心，称关税影响可能已经减弱，能源价格上涨也没有对经济的其他领域产生重大影响。

尽管他承认沃勒在接受路透社采访时表示，通胀“明显高于”美联储 2% 的目标，并指出最近的趋势“表明我们终于看到了一些通货紧缩的迹象。”

“如果未来两周公布的数据继续出现这种情况，我将倾向于支持将联邦基金利率目标维持在当前设定，”沃勒在接受路透社采访时表示。

市场隐含的 9 月 15 日至 16 日会议上加息的可能性根据 CME 集团的 FedWatch，交易员们现在的定价为 54.6%，下降了约 12 个百分点。

沃勒表示：“我将在这里套用约翰·列侬的话：给通货紧缩一个机会。我们可以等一次会议。” “等待一次会议的成本是多少？加息 25 个基点，现在召开一次会议，并不会将 CPI 降至 2%。”

这位政策制定者确实补充了警告，并指出，如果从现在到会议之间出现任何迹象，他可能会改变方针。美联储将获得的唯一主要通胀报告是美国劳工统计局下周将发布的消费者和生产者价格指数。

“我认为政策目前仅略微限制了总需求，可能不需要通胀大幅加速就能促使我支持更紧缩的政策，”沃勒表示。 “如果有证据表明8月份通胀率达到2%的进展出现逆转，我们立场上的小幅调整将有助于确保通胀率恢复。”

沃什在怀俄明州杰克逊霍尔举行的美联储年度研讨会上发表讲话时表示，最近较疲软的月度通胀数据“并没有告诉我基本趋势已经显着改善”，不到一周后，沃什就发表了上述言论。如果趋势不配合，“我们还有工作要做，”他补充道。

虽然这些声明与主席之前关于通胀的声明几乎没有什么不同，但市场认为它们对利率持强硬态度，并很快消化了即将举行的会议上加息的强烈可能性。

不过，沃勒提出了不同的看法。

尽管 7 月份总体通胀率为 3.7%，核心通胀率为 3.3%，但他表示，基本趋势实际上是“比核心数据显示的要好”，而且年度数据“并不是当前通胀状况的最佳指南”。他指出，按照美联储首选指标衡量的三个月通胀率已从 2 月份的 4.76% 下滑至目前的 3.05%。

他表示：“这是一个相当大的进步，下降轨迹的速度令人鼓舞。”

沃勒表示，某些估计而非观察到的“非市场服务价格”可能会推高通胀数据。此外，经济分析局计算个人消费支出价格指数方式的修订预计将降低今年早些时候发布的通胀数据。

title: “极端天气的危险区”：联合国警告超大规模厄尔尼诺现象将打击全球经济和市场
content:
联合国周四警告说，厄尔尼诺气候事件正在加剧为一种“超大规模”现象，将持续到 2027 年 2 月，增加许多国家发生洪水、干旱和极端高温的风险。

联合国世界气象组织秘书长 Celeste Saulo 表示，厄尔尼诺气候事件“有可能对世界各地的社区和经济造成巨大打击”。萨洛补充道：“我们已经看到干旱和洪水带来的破坏和破坏，随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，我们预计这些影响将会加剧。”

亚太和拉丁美洲国家将首当其冲地受到直接影响，但整个世界都将感受到从玉米、可可和咖啡到能源等大宗商品的影响。

危地马拉、洪都拉斯和萨尔瓦多乐施会 8 月份的一份报告将其与厄尔尼诺现象联系起来，印度尼西亚正与毁灭性的野火作斗争，经历了不稳定的天气条件和干旱，导致农作物严重损失。印度季风季节减弱预计将影响稻米、糖、棉花、大豆等作物的生长，而秘鲁官员对通常用于牲畜饲料的鳀鱼的捕捞则面临“毁灭性打击”。

极端天气预计将对能源生产和需求产生不可预测的影响，可能对水力发电、风能和太阳能输出、石油和天然气生产和炼油作业以及采矿造成干扰。

联合国秘书长安东尼奥古特雷斯周四表示，厄尔尼诺现象“在我们眼前变得非常严重”。

“世界正处于极端天气的危险地带。现在的竞赛是在不断上升的风险与我们采取气候行动和保护人民的承诺之间进行的。我们必须赢得这场竞赛。”

当热带东太平洋的海水温度比长期平均水平高出0.5摄氏度时，就会发生厄尔尼诺现象。

根据世界气象组织的最新研究，7月下旬至8月中旬期间，气温比正常水平高出2.2至2.6摄氏度。 WMO 表示，地表以下显示出“更加异常的温​​暖”，7 月和 8 月初，地下海洋温度比平均水平高出 8 摄氏度以上。

厄尔尼诺现象在西班牙语中的意思是“小男孩”，是一种自然发生的气候模式，每两到七年就会与拉尼娜现象或“小女孩”振荡一次。

title: “没有方向盘，没有踏板。”特斯拉在期待已久的 Cyber​​cab 更新之前取笑粉丝
content:
特斯拉刚刚起步的 Robotaxi 业务在 Xsaying 上发布了一篇帖子，戏弄粉丝，“没有方向盘，没有踏板”，指的是该公司即将推出的 Cyber​​cab 无人驾驶汽车。另一篇帖子促使乘客在德克萨斯州奥斯汀“尝试一下”，首席执行官埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)在一篇置顶帖子中表示，“一场网络出租车的风暴。”

周三的这些评论是在奥斯汀计划举行的活动之前发布的，预计特斯拉将于周四分享更多网络出租车的详细信息。该公司大约在两年前首次推出了这款车的设计。

马斯克的汽车制造商将 Cyber​​cab 设计为一款带有蝶形门的无人驾驶两座车，据称该车将没有方向盘或踏板。该公司一直在美国多个市场测试带有人类驾驶员和传统控制装置的“专用”机器人出租车版本。

New Street Research 分析师 Pierre Ferragu 和特斯拉粉丝周三还在 X 上分享了视频剪辑，显示赛博出租车在奥斯汀的公共街道上行驶，车上没有方向盘或驾驶员。

看涨的投资者押注该公司很快将在美国多个城市推出大量机器人出租车，因为特斯拉试图蚕食 Waymo 早期的巨大领先优势。

至少从 2016 年开始，马斯克就告诉粉丝和投资者，能够在没有任何人工干预的情况下自动驾驶穿越全国的特斯拉汽车即将问世。但这还没有发生。

特斯拉目前销售的汽车配备了名为 FSD 的系统，FSD 是全自动驾驶（监督式）的缩写。它们需要人类驾驶员留在方向盘上，随时准备转向或制动。

OneTesla Robotaxi 追踪器估计，特斯拉美国车队中有超过 200 辆车辆被注册为“无人监管”，能够在没有人类驾驶员在车的情况下运行，至少在允许它们的某些城市的地理围栏区域是这样。

特斯拉的“无人监管”车辆已记录在城市的行程跟踪器称，包括奥斯汀、达拉斯、休斯顿、迈阿密、奥兰多和佛罗里达州坦帕。

特斯拉还在旧金山地区提供包车服务，称为 FSD（监督）共享出行服务。根据特斯拉的服务条款，该车队中的汽车是由特斯拉员工驾驶的较新的 Model Y 车辆，他们使用的是该公司 FSD（受监督）版本，该版本尚未公开。乘客可以使用特斯拉 Robotaxi 品牌的应用程序叫车。

与此同时，谷歌旗下的 Waymo 正在美国 14 个城市运营商业机器人出租车服务，在美国道路上拥有约 4,000 辆无人驾驶汽车的车队，并在其他市场进行测试。

在预计 Cybercab 更新之前的一份报告中，摩根士丹利分析师表示，如果该活动“包括有意义地推出无人监管的车辆，他们预计特斯拉的股票将“恢复势头”。截至周三收盘，特斯拉股价今年已下跌约 21%。

不过，分析师表示，如果此次活动没有给人留下深刻印象，市场反应将是温和或负面的。摩根士丹利对特斯拉的目标价为 400 美元，相当于持有评级。

分析师写道：“无人监管车队（Cybercab 或 Model Y）的持续增长是该股到年底跑赢大盘的关键。”

截至周三，特斯拉在德克萨斯州注册了 420 辆无人驾驶汽车，其中有 45 辆 Cybercab 车辆获得授权用于无人驾驶运营。根据德克萨斯州机动车辆管理局网站上的公开记录，美国国家公路交通安全管理局正在至少两项正在进行的调查中对特斯拉进行调查，涉及其部分自动驾驶系统可能存在的安全缺陷。特斯拉还因要求 NHTSA 从其事故报告中删除比其他自动驾驶汽车公司更多的信息而受到批评，从而有效地将安全数据隐藏在公众视野之外。

title: 随着中国担忧的加剧，Anthropic 的蒸馏之战转向暗网
content:
Anthropic'shead of threat intelligence, Jacob Klein, says his company welcomes competition. But what's coming out of the Chinese market, he says, is something much closer to theft.

Foreign adversaries, Klein says, are accessing Anthropic's Claude models — a process known as distillation — to train competing technology and sell copycat versions at a lower price. While distillation can be done legally, Klein says that's not what's happening here.

"There's an entire illicit ecosystem to try to gain access to Claude and other models," Klein told CNBC. "This ecosystem goes through any means necessary to evade our controls, so they can spin up accounts at extreme scale."

Distillation has become acontroversial topicacross the artificial intelligence landscape. Depending on how it's conducted, the practice can allow a model developer to use the output from another company's technology to create a competitive offering at a tiny fraction of the cost. In the U.S., some factions in the tech sector haveurgedpolicymakers to steer clear of regulations so that the best and most cost-effective AI can win, while others are lobbying for acrackdownon what they see as theft of intellectual property.

In an Aprilmemo, the Trump administration wrote distillation that undermines American research and proprietary information  is "unacceptable," and said it would explore "a range of measures to hold foreign actors accountable."

The threat is intensifying at a pivotal moment for Anthropic. The 5-year-old company has soared to a private market valuation of close to $1 trillion and is expected to go public as soon as October, CNBC hasreported.

Anthropic is singling out Chinese AI lab Moonshot AI as one of the companies it says is ripping off its technology. Moonshot'sKimi K3 modeltook the tech world by storm in July with its cheaper, frontier-level AI offering. It's been widely adopted in Silicon Valley, thanks in part to its lower price point and ability for companies to tailor it more easily.

Klein said Kimi K3 was illegally trained off the newest version of Claude.

"We've seen a fair amount of this from China," Klein said. "This is something that the industry writ large is dealing with."

Earlier this year, AnthropicallegedMoonshot and two other Chinese AI labs – DeepSeek and MiniMax – distilled its frontier AI models. Anthropic has also accusedAlibaba, which makes theQwenfamily of models, of conducting a massive "distillation attack" to illegally capture capabilities from Claude. OpenAI andGooglehave both published reports on distillation and claim they're fighting the same issue.

Alibaba, DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax didn't respond to requests for comment.

Cybersecurity experts told CNBC that, in addition to China, the threat is also coming from countries like Iran, Russia and North Korea, where use of Claude, Google's Gemini and OpenAI's ChatGPT are restricted by the companies due to sanctions.

Klein said many labs in those regions "go through illicit means and fraudulent means to try to gain access to a model."

One way people are getting around those restrictions is by turning to the dark web, where they can find marketplaces of stolen credit card information and compromised AI accounts. Klein said companies like Moonshot are "spinning up tens of thousands, if not hundreds of thousands of fraudulent accounts."

Once they've accessed Anthropic's systems, they're able to ask the models questions and collect responses, which they can use to train their own model, often called the student, Klein said.

A clear sign that distillation is taking place is that a user could be asking thousands of questions, rather than dozens and potentially even creating thousands of accounts to do the same, producing a whack-a-mole scenario for the AI labs, Klein said.

"It's very hard to fully stop this as a problem, but I think slowing it down is good and worthwhile," Klein said, adding that foreign companies are able to use the technology with few guardrails.

He pointed to fears like surveillance and possible use in a biological weapons program, and noted what he described as a specific campaign from a China-based entity that was conducting espionage at scale using Anthropic's technology.

"There is a national security concern at play if malicious actors, bad actors who we don't trust are gaining access to a more capable models than they could have otherwise through the act of distillation."

Travis Lanham, technology chief at cybersecurity firm Armadin and a former Google engineer, said bad actors often go undetected because AI companies are under pressure to make their platforms as accessible as possible as they race against the competition.

"These companies are serving billions of requests," Lanham said, about the big AI labs. "The millions are relatively small compared to everything and it's just sneaking in and trying to look like the rest of the crowd."

Klein acknowledges that, for Anthropic, widespread competition is to be expected and that there are legal methods of distillation. That generally means gaining permissions and following the law on matters like IP and export controls.

"I think competition is great," Klein said. "The concern here is if you are taking our model, distilling it through fraudulent means, creating millions of fake accounts using stolen credit cards and stolen infrastructure, to then produce a model that doesn't have safeguards in place."
